acceptance: A DuckDB SF1 run exports QphDS@Size, with each input traced to its phase timing in the result.
Forcing one invalid input (for example a reused load) withholds the metric with the reason recorded.
context: 2026-11-07 delivered in PR #4036 (merge commit 1c1651e7a66131d768ac1c8c9de10b2920bd6f0d). Run: benchbox run-official tpcds --platform duckdb --scale 1 --phases generate,load,power,throughput,maintenance --streams 4 --seed 42 under notuning (no enforced keys, so the maintenance key guard did not refuse); an earlier `run --official --scale 1 --tuning notuning` without --concurrency used 2 streams and correctly withheld QphDS (stream count must be an even number of at least 4). Valid run (/tmp/rv/qphds-valid.json): qphds_at_size=511776, power_at_size=221398.7, throughput_at_size=202342.4; recomputing floor(396/(T_PT*T_TT*T_DM*T_LD)^(1/4)) matches. Inputs traced to phases: T_PT=4x power_test 2566 ms (0.0028511 h); T_TT=throughput_test 7045 ms + throughput_test_2 5673 ms (0.0035328 h); T_DM=maintenance_test 779 ms + maintenance_test_2 825 ms (0.00044556 h); T_LD=0.04 x (schema_creation 707 + data_loading 6482 ms) (7.98778e-5 h). Withholding forced through the CLI by re-running against the previous database (reused load): no qphds_at_size, qphds_unavailable records 'database load was reused, so its time was not measured in this run' (/tmp/rv/qphds-reused-load.json); power_at_size/throughput_at_size still exported. No defect found; run recorded in docs/internal/tpc-measured-intervals.md.
description:
#4016 implemented the spec QphDS@Size metric and its execution order (TPC-DS 4.0.0 clause 7.4.2), exporting it only when every input is valid. It was verified by unit tests with stubbed phases; the full sequence was not run on a platform. Maintenance now refuses to run on DuckDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite when a target table has an enforced primary key (owner decision on the dsdgen key overlap), so the run must use notuning or non-enforced keys.

Change. Run the full official TPC-DS sequence on DuckDB at SF1 with --tuning notuning. Confirm QphDS@Size is computed and exported, that each input (T_PT, T_TT1, T_TT2, T_DM1, T_DM2, T_LD) is present and comes from the right phase, and that the withholding rules trigger when an input is invalid. Fix any defect found.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
